card: U8 the producer seals seed metadata
what_ran: seed_artifact_metadata! decoded ~95 seeds per cold start (5.2% of U6/U7 samples): read bytes, sha256, beam_lib MD5, chunks, ctor/lambda origins, forwarder disassembly and binding routes

sealed_table.format: {:version 1 :compiler-key <live key> :decoder <AOT module md5> :rows {name {:sha-hex <manifest digest> :proof <deterministic term_to_binary of the proof>}}}
sealed_table.deterministic: term_to_binary [:deterministic, {:compressed 1}]; the producer's fixpoint gate sees identical bytes for identical inputs

reader.gate: table and seed dir both under /nix/store (immutable content-addressed root); a checkout or writable drop decodes as before
reader.validation: valid_seed_table?: version, compiler-key, AOT decoder md5, bounded row map; file digest keys the per-VM memo
reader.row_check: row :sha-hex must equal the manifest digest AND the proof's :sha256; otherwise decode
reader.authority: store path immutability pins table bytes; the manifest pins seed digests; the decoder md5 pins the derivation code; seed_artifact_proof still compares proof md5 with the live module and forwarders still pass Env/sdk_forwarder_current?

measured.method: test/bl/perf/seed_metadata_cost_test.bl in scripts/check-runtime-hosts on the store SDK image, load 10-18
measured.estimate: a cold start that derives N seeds saves about 2.0 ms x N (derive 2.4 ms, sealed row 0.5 ms); at the ~95 seeds seen in samples that is ~175-190 ms of ~3.4 s. Not measured on a built SDK.

tests.seed_metadata_table_test: 447 assertions, 0 failures: sealed rows equal the in-VM decode term for term for every manifest seed; row refused on digest mismatch; table refused on wrong version/key/decoder; the producer writes identical bytes twice; a written table is read through sealed_seed_table_at, a writable root and a replaced table are not
tests.gate: test/bl/seed_metadata_table_test.bl test/bl/perf/seed_metadata_cost_test.bl + the seed/publication/env list; unchanged tree gives the same environmental failures (seed_completeness, seed_dispatch_abi, env_host, env_vars, sdk_loading_batch order effects, compiler_unit_store BL_SDK_PRODUCT, retained_sdk_pin, native_runtime_custody), so the change adds none

integrator_gate: build the SDK, then run scripts/coldstart-probe/run <sdk>/bin/bl OUT plain and OUT sampler before/after (3 runs each, same load); expect the ~5% seed share to fall by the derivation of the seeds loaded. Also run the test list above on the built image.
